name: OpenTofu
description: Installs OpenTofu's tofu command, which plans and applies infrastructure-as-code configurations, from its signature-verified GitHub release archive, and requests the OpenTofu VS Code extension.

version.description: OpenTofu version to install: 'latest', the release upstream marks as latest, or a release such as 1.13.9 (a leading 'v' is accepted; 1.6.3 or later).
